aiDescriptions.n: Generate wiki and Generate labels buttons on a dataset draft text from schema and data. Docs mark the feature Preview.

bulkMetadata.n: Catalog REST API creates wikis and tags per dataset. Wikis cover sources, folders and datasets. No SQL COMMENT or column descriptions found.

autoClassify.n: No automatic PII classification found. Labels such as PII are added by hand or drafted by the AI label generator.

sampleValues.n: Docs say the AI agent uses wikis, labels and sampling to judge relevance. No value matching or stored sample values documented.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history to suggest joins, metrics or examples documented. The AI agent keeps per-user chat history only.

lineage.n: Lineage graph shows source, parent and child datasets. Docs describe no column-level lineage.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling documented. The AI agent has a feedback dialog that sends chat data to Dremio.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Turn on AI under Admin > Project > AI, then use Generate wiki and Generate labels on each dataset and review the text. For scripted writes, call the Catalog API: POST /v0/projects/{project_id}/catalog/{id}/collaboration/wiki for wikis and .../collaboration/tag for labels, one dataset per call.

aiDescriptions.n: Denodo Assistant suggests view and column descriptions from sample data and metadata. Added in 9.1 (Nov 2024). Needs the AI & Denodo Assistant FeaturePack.

bulkMetadata.n: VQL DESCRIPTION clause sets view descriptions. Stored procedures DENODO_ASSISTANT_GENERATE_VIEW_DESCRIPTION and _FIELDS_DESCRIPTION draft text per view.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification in the feature pack list. Tags are applied by hand and drive Global Security Policies.

sampleValues.n: AI SDK samples values per view when it vectorizes metadata. Set examples_per_table = 0 to turn it off. SDK is a separate download.

queryHistory.n: Assistant suggests filters, derived fields and cached summaries from past query activity. Needs the AI & Denodo Assistant FeaturePack (Enterprise Plus).

lineage.n: COLUMN_DEPENDENCIES returns column-level lineage for derived views, the same data as the Data Lineage dialog in Design Studio.

evals.n: AI SDK Evaluator runs questions against ground-truth VQL and reports F1, overlap and efficiency score in an Excel report.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Configure Denodo Assistant, then call DENODO_ASSISTANT_GENERATE_VIEW_DESCRIPTION and DENODO_ASSISTANT_GENERATE_FIELDS_DESCRIPTION for each view, or use the Assistant in Design Studio. Review the text and write it back with the VQL DESCRIPTION clause. Maximum description length is 4,000 characters.

bulkSnippet.code:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW customer360
 DESCRIPTION = 'This is the view that business users need to use to obtain all the information of the customer'
AS SELECT ...

aiDescriptions.n: AI agent enrichment drafts data product, dataset and column descriptions. Automatic Metadata Enrichment announced GA May 2026. Galaxy has Enrich with AIDA.

bulkMetadata.n: Trino COMMENT ON TABLE, VIEW, MATERIALIZED VIEW, COLUMN sets one object per statement. Connector support is not covered on that page.

autoClassify.n: Galaxy data classifier jobs scan catalogs, schemas and tables, then propose attribute tags for PII and location columns. Admins accept or reject.

sampleValues.n: Enrichment can sample rows and column stats into descriptions (public preview). AIDA runs exploratory LIMIT queries before final SQL.

queryHistory.n: AIDA keeps chat history and audit logs. Docs describe no mining of query history for suggestions. Enrichment infers joins from dataset SQL.

lineage.n: Galaxy data lineage shows table and column lineage, one hop each way. Public preview, Galaxy only.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling or rating loop found in AIDA docs. Business rules and skills steer answers.

vendors.enrichHowTo: In the Data products tab, select a data product and click Enrich with AI (Enrich with AIDA in Galaxy), enable data sampling if allowed, then review and save. For scripted writes, run Trino COMMENT ON COLUMN statements, one per column. Enrichment needs AI workflows and Agentic layer licenses and starburst.agent.enabled=true.

bulkSnippet.code:
COMMENT ON TABLE users IS 'master table';
COMMENT ON COLUMN users.name IS 'full name';

aiDescriptions.n: Auto-generated descriptions for concepts, properties, relationships, measures, views and cubes (release 2.52.0, Jan 2026). Bulk generation in Ontology Explorer.

bulkMetadata.n: SQL DDL sets concept descriptions, relationship descriptions and tags. Property-level description DDL not found. Bulk AI description generation announced March 2026.

autoClassify.n: No automatic PII or semantic-type classification found in docs or changelog. Tags are set by hand with ALTER CONCEPT ... TAG.

sampleValues.n: Ontology Explorer fetches 50 sample rows for people. Knowledge Base instructions map business terms to measures. No value matching for NL-to-SQL found.

queryHistory.n: No query-log mining. Benchmarks import questions from agent conversation history, and Knowledge Base suggestions come from user feedback.

lineage.n: Data Lineage view and SYS_LINEAGE table cover datasources, tables, mappings, concepts, views and properties. Source-column depth not stated.

evals.n: Benchmarks run question sets with known answers against agents. Knowledge Base can turn user feedback into suggested examples.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Use Ontology Explorer to generate descriptions for concepts, properties and measures with the active LLM, then review them. For scripted writes, use SQL DDL: CREATE OR REPLACE CONCEPT ... DESCRIPTION, ALTER CONSTRAINT ... SET DESCRIPTION for relationships, and ALTER CONCEPT ... UPDATE TAG for tags.

bulkSnippet.code:
ALTER CONSTRAINT `{relationship_name}` SET DESCRIPTION = '{description value}';
ALTER CONCEPT `{concept_name}` UPDATE TAG `{tag_name}` = '{tag_value}';

sources.t: Timbr: active LLM management and accelerated ontology generation (2026-03-09)

aiDescriptions.n: dbt Copilot and dbt Wizard generate documentation, tests and semantic models. Copilot in Insights is Beta; Wizard is the recommended agent.

bulkMetadata.n: Descriptions live in YAML. persist_docs writes them as database comments on supported adapters. dbt-codegen generates model YAML for many models.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification in dbt docs. Teams set tags and meta in YAML by hand or use a catalog tool.

sampleValues.n: dbt MCP get_dimension_values returns distinct values for a Semantic Layer dimension, so agents can match literals.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history to suggest metrics or examples found in dbt docs.

lineage.n: Column-level lineage in dbt Catalog (Enterprise plans) and locally with dbt v2 and the VS Code extension.

evals.n: dbt data tests check models, not NL-to-SQL accuracy. No eval set tooling for the text_to_sql tool found.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Generate model YAML with the dbt-codegen macro generate_model_yaml (upstream_descriptions copies matching column descriptions), fill in descriptions with dbt Wizard or by hand, then set persist_docs for relation and columns so dbt writes them as database comments on each run.

aiDescriptions.n: No dedicated generate-description action found. The Cube Cloud IDE agent edits data model files on request.

bulkMetadata.n: description and meta.ai_context sit in YAML model files in Git. cube_dbt renders cubes from dbt manifest.json with dbt descriptions.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification found in Cube docs. Teams tag by hand in meta or use a catalog.

sampleValues.n: No automatic value sampling found. Docs suggest listing allowed values in description or ai_context text.

queryHistory.n: Query History and Chats History are monitoring views. No mining of history to suggest metrics or examples found.

lineage.n: No lineage feature found in Cube docs index. Pre-aggregation and query monitoring exist, not column lineage.

evals.n: Evals tab benchmarks the agent against questions with ground-truth SQL or certified queries and reports accuracy per run.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write description on every cube, view, measure and dimension, and add meta.ai_context on views and members for agent-only hints such as synonyms. If you use dbt, cube_dbt can render cubes from manifest.json including model descriptions. Commit the YAML to Git and review changes there.

bulkSnippet.code:
from cube_dbt import Dbt

dbt = Dbt.from_url(manifest_url)
model = dbt.model('orders')
print(model.as_cube())  # name, description, sql_table

aiDescriptions.n: No description generator found in AtScale docs. One-Click Modeling (2025) proposes metrics, dimensions and relationships, not descriptions.

bulkMetadata.n: SML objects carry description and label in YAML kept in Git. The open-source SML SDK reads and writes them in code.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification found in AtScale docs.

sampleValues.n: Designer shows dataset sample rows for modelers. MCP explore_columns returns names and descriptions, not values.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history to suggest metrics or examples found in the docs reviewed.

lineage.n: Lineage panel shows dependencies between SML objects, not source columns. Alation and Collibra connectors export model metadata.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling found in AtScale or AI-Link docs.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Add description and label to each SML object (model, dimension, metric) in the Git repository and deploy. For many objects, script the edits with the open-source SML SDK or CLI, or convert an existing model with the SML converters. Review changes in pull requests.

bulkSnippet.code:
unique_name: m_catalog_sales_coupon_amount_avg
object_type: metric
label: Catalog Sales Average Coupon Amount
description: Average coupon amount per catalog sale
calculation_method: average
dataset: catalog_sales
column: cs_sales_price

aiDescriptions.n: The enrich-context skill has your own coding agent write definitions and examples into project files. AI-assisted context preparation is a commercial Cloud feature.

bulkMetadata.n: Metadata is YAML and Markdown files in Git. wren context import brings dbt, OpenMetadata and Ossie metadata, including descriptions, into a project.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification found in the README or CLI reference.

sampleValues.n: dbt import carries accepted_values tests as filter values. The README lists value profiling as both shipped and upcoming; the CLI documents no sampling command.

queryHistory.n: wren memory store saves NL-SQL pairs by hand. Docs list the behavioral layer as in active development. No mining of warehouse query history.

lineage.n: No lineage feature found in the README or CLI reference. dbt import reads refs and tests, not column lineage.

evals.n: Golden eval runner is listed under what is next, not shipped. Docs list evaluation as part of the planned context layer.

vendors.enrichHowTo: If you use dbt, run wren context import dbt to carry model and column descriptions and tests into the project. Then add definitions, enums and example NL-SQL pairs with the enrich-context skill or by editing instructions.md and knowledge/ files, and review them in Git.

aiDescriptions.n: No AI description generation found in Malloy docs. Descriptions are written by hand as #" annotations.

bulkMetadata.n: Descriptions and tags are #" and # annotations in .malloy text files, so scripts and Git can edit them in bulk. No metadata API.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification found in Malloy docs.

sampleValues.n: The index query operator builds fieldName, fieldValue and weight tables. Docs say LLMs can use it for term-to-column mapping. Run manually.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history found in Malloy or Publisher docs.

lineage.n: No lineage feature found in Malloy or Publisher docs.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling found in Malloy or Publisher docs.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write a #" annotation above each source and field you want described; the explorer renders it as Markdown. Edit the .malloy files in bulk with scripts or an AI coding agent and review in Git. Malloy does not have a metadata API.

aiDescriptions.n: AI-specific descriptions are written in Studio or YAML. An AI coding agent connected through the Honeydew MCP server can add and refine them.

bulkMetadata.n: Metadata (description, synonyms, values, labels) is YAML in Git. GraphQL API can import metadata from another system.

autoClassify.n: No automatic column classification found in Honeydew docs. Labels are set by hand for lightweight governance.

sampleValues.n: AI metadata has a values list per field. Studio page for semantic context loads sample values (release note, Jan 2026).

queryHistory.n: Query history (14 days) and question history are monitoring views. No mining of them to suggest metrics or examples found.

lineage.n: Honeydew publishes lineage from attributes and metrics to warehouse columns into Atlan. The integration is Beta.

evals.n: Deep Analysis answers can be rated and commented on. Feedback is stored for the team to review, not turned into examples.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Put an AI-specific description, synonyms and allowed values in the honeydew_ai metadata block of each attribute, metric and entity, in Studio or in the YAML files. Use an AI coding agent through the Honeydew MCP server to draft them, then review in Git. Descriptive object names matter most.

bulkSnippet.code:
metadata:
  - name: honeydew_ai
    metadata:
      - name: description
        value: This is an AI-specific description for the attribute
      - name: synonyms
        value: synonym1, synonym2

notes.topic: Dremio AI wiki and label status
notes.text: Dremio docs mark Generate wiki and Generate labels as Preview. The Catalog API manages wikis and tags per dataset; column descriptions have no documented API.
A May 2026 release announces AIDA and Automatic Metadata Enrichment as GA. Data sampling inside enrichment and Galaxy column lineage are public preview.

sources.t: Starburst AI agent-based data product enrichment

notes.text: Denodo Assistant features sit in the AI & Denodo Assistant FeaturePack, which is a separately licensed add-on to the Enterprise Plus bundle.
dbt Labs now recommends dbt Wizard over dbt Copilot. Copilot remains in Canvas and Insights, and Copilot in Insights is Beta.
Wren docs list the operational and behavioral context layers as in active development, and value profiling and a golden eval runner as next. Treat them as not shipped.
Cube's Apache Ossie conversion page says it is in preview and needs activation by support.
